verdict.rationale: LangGraph has an official, first-party CLI: the LangGraph CLI builds and runs the Agent Server locally. That server exposes API endpoints for runs, threads and assistants, plus a managed database for checkpointing and storage. A community thread independently references running `langgraph serve` locally. Missing for 10: a documented command reference (beyond build/run of the local server), any evidence of AI-native or agent-friendly CLI features such as machine-readable output or scripting, and hands-on corroboration of CLI workflows beyond a passing mention.
